title: Identification of the shared gene signatures and pathways between polycystic ovary syndrome and endometrial cancer: An omics data based combined approach.
authors: Miao, Chenyun; Chen, Yun; Fang, Xiaojie; Zhao, Ying; Wang, Ruye; Zhang, Qin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过组学数据挖掘PCOS与子宫内膜癌共享基因及通路，虽含分子对接但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder with high incidence. Recently it has been implicated as a significant risk factor for endometrial cancer (EC). Our study aims to detect shared gene signatures and biological mechanism between PCOS and EC by bioinformatics analysis. METHODS: Bioinformatics analysis based on GEO database consisted of data integration, network construction and functional enrichment analysis was applied. In addition, the pharmacological methodology and molecular docking was also performed. RESULTS: Totally 10 hub common genes, MRPL16, MRPL22, MRPS11, RPL26L1, ESR1, JUN, UBE2I, MRPL17, RPL37A, GTF2H3, were considered as shared gene signatures for EC and PCOS. The GO and KEGG pathway analysis of these hub genes showed that "mitochondrial translational elongation", "ribosomal subunit", "structural constituent of ribosome" and "ribosome" were highly correlated. Besides, associated transcription factors (TFs) and miRNAs network were constructed. We identified candidate drug molecules including fenofibrate, cinnarizine, propanil, fenthion, clindamycin, chloramphenicol, demeclocycline, hydrochloride, azacitidine, chrysene and artenimol according to these hub genes. Molecular docking analysis verified a good binding interaction of fenofibrate against available targets (JUN, ESR1, UBE2I). CONCLUSION: Gene signatures and regulatory biological pathways were identified through bioinformatics analysis. Moreover, the molecular mechanisms of these signatures were explored and potential drug molecules associated with PCOS and EC were screened out.
abstract_zh: 目的：多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是一种发病率较高的常见内分泌疾病。近期研究表明其是子宫内膜癌（EC）的重要风险因素。本研究旨在通过生物信息学分析，检测PCOS与EC之间的共享基因特征及生物学机制。方法：基于GEO数据库的生物信息学分析包括数据整合、网络构建和功能富集分析。此外，还进行了药理学方法和分子对接研究。结果：共识别出10个核心共有基因，即MRPL16、MRPL22、MRPS11、RPL26L1、ESR1、JUN、UBE2I、MRPL17、RPL37A、GTF2H3，作为EC和PCOS的共享基因特征。这些核心基因的GO和KEGG通路分析显示，“线粒体翻译延伸”、“核糖体亚基”、“核糖体结构成分”和“核糖体”高度相关。此外，构建了相关的转录因子（TFs）和miRNA网络。根据这些核心基因，我们筛选出候选药物分子，包括非诺贝特、桂利嗪、敌稗、倍硫磷、克林霉素、氯霉素、地美环素、盐酸盐、阿扎胞苷、�并芘和青蒿素。分子对接分析验证了非诺贝特与可用靶点（JUN、ESR1、UBE2I）的良好结合相互作用。结论：通过生物信息学分析识别了基因特征和调控生物学通路。此外，探讨了这些特征的分子机制，并筛选出与PCOS和EC相关的潜在药物分子。
